description: Contests, game shows, and award ceremonies held at DEF CON 33, including Hacker Jeopardy, Whose Slide Is It Anyway, and the annual Pwnie Awards.

talks.title: Hacker Jeopardy: Friday Night
talks.teaser: The Friday night edition of Hacker Jeopardy at DEF CON 33, featuring intense cybersecurity trivia, obscure hacker lore, and adult beverages.

talks.title: Hacker Jeopardy: Saturday Night
talks.teaser: The Saturday night championship round of Hacker Jeopardy at DEF CON 33, testing the brightest minds in infosec across high-stakes categories.

talks.title: Whose Slide Is It Anyway?
talks.teaser: Hacker contestants improvise technical presentations on the fly using completely unfamiliar and absurd slide decks at DEF CON 33.

talks.title: The 2025 Pwnie Awards
talks.teaser: Ian Roos and Mark Trumpbour host the 2025 Pwnie Awards celebrating the year's greatest security achievements, best bugs, and epic fails.
